description: This Java class defines the response to a 'DeleteFeatureDefinition' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It models the information returned after deleting a feature definition from a thing, including serialization/deserialization methods, and accessors for thing ID and feature ID.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a delete feature definition command, including serialization/deserialization logic and accessors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance by ThingId, feature ID, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object and headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose definition was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the JSON payload with thing ID and feature ID.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
